name: Pyrohypha celerrima
story: Appears on ground too hot for anything else and crosses it at the engine's top speed. Its hyphae are abandoned within hours and it fruits in a day. Invented by Claude on 2026-11-10 for the plugins: not a real species, and any likeness of the name to a real one is accidental. It takes every value it does not set from the DIF family.
